subject: Community Social Work and Substance Use Services
overview: Community Social Worker Alicia LaGambina discussed the expansion of Medford's social service initiatives, focusing on substance use recovery, harm reduction, and the city's new jail diversion clinician program. The discussion outlined how various city departments coordinate to address housing instability, mental health crises, and linguistic barriers to services.

items.title: Introduction and Podcast Updates
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca opened the episode with a call for listener feedback and introduced guest Alicia LaGambina.

items.title: Role of the Community Social Worker
items.summary: LaGambina described her transition from a recovery coach to a social worker within the Health Department's Office of Prevention and Outreach, where she focuses on social determinants of health.

items.title: Substance Use Recovery and Harm Reduction
items.summary: The Health Department conducts post-overdose door knocks with police, provides naloxone training, and hosts a weekly peer recovery group at City Hall.

items.title: Case Management and Outreach Initiatives
items.summary: The city provides advocacy and resource connection for food insecurity and housing, including direct outreach to unhoused residents to provide basic supplies and cooling center information.

items.title: Hub Table and Inter-departmental Coordination
items.summary: A weekly 'hub table' meeting allows social service agencies, emergency responders, and schools to coordinate support for high-risk individuals and families.

items.title: Jail Diversion Clinicians and Police Collaboration
items.summary: LaGambina announced the arrival of three jail diversion clinicians who co-respond with police to mental health calls to avoid involuntary commitments and jail time.

items.title: Linguistic Accessibility and Equity
items.summary: The Office of Prevention and Outreach is translating city resources into multiple languages and navigating cultural differences in how health and wellness are defined.

items.title: Resource Access and Contact Information
items.summary: LaGambina provided contact details for the multilingual resource line and the outreach team to assist residents in need of services.
